scripts.build: npm run build -w @rata/tokens && npm run build:themes && npm run build -w @rata/css && npm run build -w @rata/primitives && npm run build -w @rata/icons && npm run build -w @rata/react && npm run registry:check && npm run aria:check && npm run docs:components && npm run playground:check && npm run ui:sync
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rata/react && npm run typecheck -w @rata/icons
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test -w @rata/primitives && npm run test -w @rata/react && npm run test -w @rata/icons && npm run test:theme
scripts.build:playground: npm run build && npm run build -w playground
